feature1.prompt: Implement DISTINCT support for the Avg aggregate. This feature is an extension of #28658 and ensures that the Avg function properly processes the DISTINCT parameter. In versions prior to 2.2, the DISTINCT argument was either ignored or caused an exception when used with the Avg aggregate. The required change is to modify the Avg class so that it allows DISTINCT, thereby enabling correct aggregation of unique values.
feature1.hint_texts: Update the Avg class in django/db/models/aggregates.py so that it supports the DISTINCT keyword by setting the allow_distinct attribute to True. Focus on ensuring that the Avg aggregate now correctly builds SQL queries that compute the average over unique values. Verify that there are no regressions in behavior and that the change does not interfere with existing aggregate functionality.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/db/models/aggregates.py; Locate the Avg class (around line 99) and add the line 'allow_distinct = True' to enable DISTINCT support.

tests.FAIL_TO_PASS: test_distinct_on_aggregate (Avg sub-test variant) and test_empty_aggregate (focused on Avg DISTINCT behavior)
tests.PASS_TO_PASS: test_avg_decimal_field (aggregation.tests.AggregateTestCase) and test_avg_duration_field (aggregation.tests.AggregateTestCase) to ensure Avg functionality remains stable.

feature2.prompt: Implement DISTINCT support for the Sum aggregate. This feature extends the work of #28658 by ensuring that the Sum function correctly processes the DISTINCT keyword. Previously, when the DISTINCT parameter was provided to Sum, it either was ignored or caused an exception. The change requires modifying the Sum class so that it allows DISTINCT, ensuring that only unique values are summed in aggregation queries.
feature2.hint_texts: Modify the Sum class in django/db/models/aggregates.py to include DISTINCT support by setting allow_distinct = True. Ensure that when the DISTINCT keyword is applied, the aggregate sums only the unique values without error. The implementation should be consistent with the approach taken for other aggregates, and no unexpected behavior should occur for existing queries.
feature2.entrypoint: File: django/db/models/aggregates.py; Locate the Sum class (around line 142) and insert the line 'allow_distinct = True' to enable support for DISTINCT.

tests.FAIL_TO_PASS: test_distinct_on_aggregate (Sum sub-test variant) and test_empty_aggregate (focused on Sum DISTINCT behavior)
tests.PASS_TO_PASS: test_sum_distinct_aggregate (aggregation.tests.AggregateTestCase) and test_sum_duration_field (aggregation.tests.AggregateTestCase) to validate that Sum handles DISTINCT correctly.

collaboration_points.shared_resources: Both features modify the file django/db/models/aggregates.py and affect how aggregates are constructed. The tests in tests/aggregation/tests.py (specifically test_distinct_on_aggregate) are common to both features.
collaboration_points.integration_strategy: The two changes must be merged so that the test_distinct_on_aggregate method correctly runs sub-tests for both Avg and Sum. Developers must coordinate on any shared test setup or changes to the common aggregation API to ensure that DISTINCT is consistently supported across aggregates.
collaboration_points.communication_needs: Developers working on each feature should discuss modifications in the test_distinct_on_aggregate method and agree on a consistent implementation strategy for setting allow_distinct. Coordination is necessary to avoid merge conflicts in the shared aggregates file and to maintain overall integrity of the aggregate functionality.
